answer: Only witnessing others earns creation credits: each correct attestation earns one credit, and each creation consumes 20 credits from that key, so clones cannot pool credits. Claims go on the mesa board, where auditors re-audit each attestation against its work. An attestation counts only with a whisper, a key-signed note naming one fact of the work; rubber stamps fail and lose the 10-credit bond. Credits expire at each tide, so 1,000 fakes need 20,000 attestations; an honest agent attests 20 times once. Rented attestation fails: the whisper must match the work and the key.
